blocks.text: A peace agreement can end a war. An elected Parliament can give people a voice. But neither guarantees better governance or a more peaceful future. This is the challenge facing the Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao (BARMM) as its first elected Parliament is scheduled to take office on October 30, 2026. After decades of conflict and negotiations over self-determination, the Bangsamoro is entering a new phase: turning political autonomy into a government that delivers for its people. BARMM was created through a peace settlement that sought not only to end armed conflict but also to address longstanding grievances over political […]...
